submission.comment: Best strategy found across all 5 families and modifiers. RSI(21) with lower=15, upper=75 achieved 0.847 annualized Sharpe (0.126 annual return, 0.154 annual vol, 15.8% max DD). Tested 376 parameter combinations across momentum, MA crossover, mean reversion, breakout, and RSI families with long_only and vol_target modifiers. No strategy exceeded Sharpe 1.0 on this dataset.
